tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary of Energy shall carry out a basic research program on quantum information science.

tree.heading: Program components
tree.text: In carrying out the program under subsection (a), the Secretary of Energy shall—

children.text: formulate goals for quantum information science research to be supported by the Department of Energy;
leverage the collective body of knowledge from existing quantum information science research;
provide research experiences and training for additional undergraduate and graduate students in quantum information science, including in the fields of—
coordinate research efforts funded through existing programs across the Department of Energy, including—
the Advanced Research Projects Agency; and
the National Quantum Information Science Research Centers; and
coordinate with other Federal departments and agencies, research communities, and potential users of information produced under this section.
